segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Just so you know, this call may be recorded. Could you please give me your first and last name, your date of birth,

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: And the reason for your call today?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: My name's Maya Thompson. I was born March 12, 1991, and I'm calling because my right knee's been hurting for about two weeks, and I'd like to book a first appointment.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Welcome to Sunrise Orthopedics, Maya. Since you're dealing with knee pain, I can schedule you with Dr. Emily Chen, who specializes in knees and hips. We have an opening this coming Tuesday at 9 a.m. or Wednesday at 2 p.m.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: Would either of those work for you?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Tuesday at 9 sounds good. Does that appointment with Dr. Chen confirm for then?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.text: You are all set for Tuesday at 9 a.m. with Dr. Chen. Since you're a new patient, please arrive 15 minutes early with a photo ID and your insurance card.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I've got a Blue Shield PPO, so I'll bring that card with me, and I'll make sure to get there a little before nine then. Thanks. Goodbye.
